scope: Source mask quality audit for the fixed 914 C0 test flood post-pair items; descriptive exposed development data
population: Select partition=test, phen=flood, kind in [pos,hard_neg] from frozen items; exact source ID/kind/slots/label contracts and 457 rows per kind
symmetric_subset: Apply identical valid_frac>=0.90 rule to pos and hard_neg; publish all selected and excluded IDs without reading predictions or scores
raw_validation: 192x192 integer arrays; mask values in 0..3 and valid in 0..1; E1 source-label thresholds and rounded fraction agreement must hold
source_audit: Hash original cache .npy bytes before and after each read, and again at audit completion; retain class/valid cross counts and row/column labelled/flood pixel counts
failure_policy: Exclusive output directory; abort on any invalid source, preserve partial output and error/status; no dropping invalid items or overwriting a prior run
nonclaims: No model evaluation, calibration, ranking or threshold search
No independent confirmation of original flood labels
No claim that the retained quality subset preserves both classes within each event/date stratum
